sys_script_include.description: Stages a batch of HP WXP alerts into x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_hp_alert_inc_import_set and runs the 'HP WXP Alert to Incident' transform map synchronously, so the caller gets the incident number back in the same response. Backs the POST /alerts resource of the alert_import Scripted REST API.
sys_script_include.name: AlertIngest
